name: codx-junior mobile
description:
## Summary

The conversation presents a full architectural design (AS IS → TO BE) for adding mobile support to **codx-junior-ui**, a Vue.js desktop app built around `dockview-vue` with 19 dockable panels. The existing `Desktop.vue` uses `renderer: 'always'` keeping all panels mounted simultaneously, causing memory concerns on mobile. The proposed solution introduces a parallel `MobileLayout.vue` shell with a bottom navigation bar, top app bar, and a "More" bottom sheet drawer — reusing all existing panel components without modifying `Desktop.vue`. Memory is managed via `<keep-alive :max="3">` with `defineAsyncComponent` lazy loading, replacing the always-mounted desktop strategy. Four new files are added (`MobileLayout.vue`, `BottomNavBar.vue`, `TopAppBar.vue`, `MoreDrawer.vue`) plus two composables (`useDevice.js`, `useMobileLayout.js`), with only `App.vue` modified to route between desktop and mobile shells.

We must create a mobile version from it. Analyze the project and create a document explaining how it's is now, which components and functionalities  has. Create the "AS IS" document only, If you are missing something or need help add your questions at the end of the document.

# AS IS Document: codx-junior Desktop Layout

## Project Overview

**Project Name:** codx-junior-ui  
**Framework:** Vue.js (Composition API + Options API)  
**Layout Type:** Multi-dockable Windows Interface (Desktop-first)  
**Docking Library:** `dockview-vue`

---

## Current Architecture

### Entry Point & Layout Engine

The desktop layout is orchestrated by a single component:

```vue client/src/components/desktop/Desktop.vue
<!-- Already exists - see project files -->
```

The `Desktop.vue` component acts as the **root layout manager**. It:
- Initializes the `DockviewVue` engine
- Manages panel lifecycle (add, remove, restore)
- Persists layout state via `localStorage`
- Bridges the UI store (`$ui`) with the docking system

---

## Component Registry

The following components are registered as **dockable panels**:

| Panel Key | Component | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `window` | `Window.vue` | Generic window wrapper |
| `app-window` | `AppWindow.vue` | Application window container |
| `log-viewer` | `LogViewer.vue` | Real-time log display |
| `knowledge` | `KnowledgeView.vue` | Knowledge base browser |
| `knowledge_settings` | `KnowledgeSettings.vue` | Knowledge base configuration |
| `profiles` | `ProfileView.vue` | User profile management |
| `home` | `CodxWelcomeView.vue` | Welcome / landing screen |
| `settings` | `ProjectSettings.vue` | Per-project configuration |
| `wiki` | `WikiView.vue` | Project wiki reader |
| `docs` | `DocsView.vue` | Documentation viewer |
| `global-settings` | `GlobalSettings.vue` | Global application settings |
| `tasks` | `KanbanContainer.vue` | Kanban-style task manager |
| `files` | `Files.vue` | File manager/browser |
| `metrics` | `MetricsViewer.vue` | Project metrics dashboard |
| `account` | `AccountSettings.vue` | Account & security settings |
| `file-finder` | `FileFinder.vue` | File search tool |
| `projects` | `ProjectOverview.vue` | Multi-project overview |
| `activity` | `Wall.vue` | Activity feed/wall |
| `chat` | `ChatView.vue` | AI chat interface |

**Total registered panels: 19**

---

## Layout Management System

### Panel Lifecycle

```
User Action
    │
    ▼
$ui.showTab(name)
    │
    ▼
addAppPanel(app)
    │
    ▼
dockviewApi.addPanel({ id, title, component, renderer, params })
    │
    ▼
Panel renders inside DockviewVue grid
```

### State Persistence

- Layout is serialized via `dockviewApi.toJSON()`
- Stored in `localStorage` under key `dockview-layout`
- Restored on app load via `dockviewApi.fromJSON(data)`
- Events that trigger auto-save:
  - `onDidAddPanel`
  - `onDidRemovePanel`
  - `onDidLayoutChange`

### Panel Rendering Mode

Panels use `renderer: 'always'` — meaning panels remain **mounted in the DOM** even when not in focus, preserving their state.

---

## UI Store Integration (`$ui`)

The Desktop component communicates with a global UI store (`$ui`) for:

| Store Property/Method | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `$ui.openApps` | Registry of currently open application panels |
| `$ui.showTab(name)` | Programmatically open a panel by name |
| `$ui.showApp(app)` | Register an app as active |
| `$ui.closeApp(app)` | Mark app as closed when panel is removed |
| `$ui.uiReady` | Guards layout restoration until app is fully initialized |

### Chat Store Integration (`$chats`)

On layout restore, chat panels are rehydrated:
```js
this.$chats.reloadChat(panel.params.chat)
```

---

## Tab System

Each panel has a custom tab component:

```
Tab.vue → tabComponent
```

Registered as `tabComponent: Tab` in the component definition, allowing custom tab rendering (icons, close buttons, drag handles).

---

## Exposed Public API

The `Desktop.vue` component exposes the following methods for external use:

| Method | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `addPanel` | `({ id, title, component, position, params, renderer })` | Add a new dockable panel |
| `removePanel` | `(id: string)` | Remove panel by ID |
| `registerComponent` | `(name, component)` | Register a new component type |
| `saveLayout` | `()` | Serialize and save layout to localStorage |
| `restoreLayout` | `(layout?)` | Restore layout from localStorage or given JSON |
| `clearSavedLayout` | `()` | Delete persisted layout |
| `getLayout` | `()` | Get current layout as JSON (no save) |

---

## Backend Integration

### Wiki Manager (`wiki_manager.py`)

The wiki system provides AI-powered documentation generation:

- Scans project files and organizes into **categories**
- Uses AI (LLM) to generate markdown documentation per file
- Supports **MkDocs** and **VitePress** output formats
- Wiki settings persisted in `.codx/wiki_settings.json`
- Categories support hierarchical structure (parent/child)
- Parallelized document generation via `ThreadPoolExecutor`

### Knowledge System (`knowledge_milvus.py`)

Referenced in `context.py`, provides:
- **RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation)** document search
- AI-powered document relevance scoring
- Parallel context validation via `ThreadPoolExecutor`
- Score-based document filtering (`knowledge_context_cutoff_relevance_score`)

### Code Chunking (`code_to_chunks.md`)

A prompt template that splits source files into semantically meaningful chunks for the knowledge search engine, preserving:
- File path, language, class context
- Keywords for retrieval
- Human-readable documentation per chunk

---

## Current Layout Behavior

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                     DockviewVue Grid                        │
│  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────────┐  │
│  │   Panel A    │  │   Panel B    │  │    Panel C       │  │
│  │  (chat)      │  │  (wiki)      │  │  (tasks/kanban)  │  │
│  │              │  │              │  │                  │  │
│  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘  └──────────────────┘  │
│  ┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │              Panel D (files / metrics)                │  │
│  └───────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

- Panels are **freely resizable and repositionable**
- Users can **drag panels** to rearrange
- Multiple panels can be **tabbed** within the same dock zone
- Layout fully **persists across sessions**

---

## Known Limitations / Open Questions

1. **No Mobile Layout Exists** — The entire layout relies on `dockview-vue` which is a desktop-oriented docking library. No responsive breakpoints or mobile-specific routing is implemented.

2. **`renderer: 'always'` Memory Impact** — With 19 possible panels all mounted simultaneously, memory usage on low-end devices (especially mobile) could be significant. No lazy-loading strategy is currently defined.

3. **`$ui` Store Contract** — The internal structure of `$ui` (Pinia store or Vue plugin?) is referenced but not visible in the provided files. Understanding its full API is needed before designing a mobile equivalent.

4. **`$chats` Store Contract** — Similarly, the chat rehydration logic (`$chats.reloadChat`) is not fully documented in the provided files.

5. **Panel Deduplication Strategy** — Panels are deduplicated by `id` only. If the same logical view is opened from different contexts, behavior is undefined.

6. **Auth / Security Layer** — `AccountSettings.vue` exists but the security model (session management, token storage) is not described.

7. **Navigation Model for Mobile** — Should mobile use a bottom navigation bar? A hamburger drawer? A tab-based router? This is not yet defined.

8. **Which panels are "primary" on mobile?** — Not all 19 panels have equal importance. A prioritization of panels for mobile (e.g., `chat`, `tasks`, `files` as primary; `metrics`, `log-viewer` as secondary/hidden) has not been defined.

9. **Deep Linking** — Does the app support URL-based navigation to specific panels? This would be important for mobile UX.

10. **VitePress / MkDocs wiki** — The wiki is rendered externally (VitePress/MkDocs). How this integrates within the mobile app shell (iframe? embedded? external link?) is unclear.

# Conversation Summary: codx-junior-ui Mobile Layout Design

## Context
Design document (AS IS → TO BE) for adding mobile support to **codx-junior-ui**, a Vue.js desktop docking panel application.

---

## AS IS: Desktop Architecture

- **Root component:** `Desktop.vue` using `dockview-vue` library
- **19 registered dockable panels** (chat, tasks, files, wiki, kanban, knowledge, settings, etc.)
- **Panel lifecycle:** `$ui.showTab(name)` → `addAppPanel()` → `dockviewApi.addPanel()`
- **Persistence:** `dockviewApi.toJSON()` → `localStorage['dockview-layout']`
- **Rendering:** `renderer: 'always'` — all panels stay mounted in DOM simultaneously
- **Tab system:** Custom `Tab.vue` component per panel
- **Store integrations:** `$ui` (open apps, tab management) + `$chats` (chat rehydration on restore)
- **Auto-save triggers:** `onDidAddPanel`, `onDidRemovePanel`, `onDidLayoutChange`

### Key Limitations
- No mobile layout exists
- `renderer: 'always'` causes high memory usage with 19 panels
- `$ui` and `$chats` store contracts undocumented
- No deep linking / URL navigation
- No responsive breakpoints

---

## TO BE: Mobile Layout Design

### Core Principle
> Same stores + same panel components, different shell. `Desktop.vue` untouched.

### Device Routing (`App.vue`)
```
isMobile (window.innerWidth < 768) → <MobileLayout />
else → <Desktop />
```

### Shell Structure (`MobileLayout.vue`)
- **TopAppBar** — title + hamburger + notifications + avatar
- **Main area** — `<keep-alive :include="recentViews" :max="3">` wrapping active component
- **BottomNavBar** — 4 tabs: Tasks | Chat | Files | More
- **MoreDrawer** — bottom sheet grid with all 14 remaining panels

### Panel Priority Tiers
| Tier | Panels | Cache Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| Primary | `tasks`, `chat`, `files` | Always cached, eagerly loaded |
| Secondary | `activity`, `projects`, `wiki`, `docs`, `profiles` | `defineAsyncComponent`, cached up to max=3 |
| Tertiary | `metrics`, `log-viewer`, `knowledge`, `knowledge_settings`, `settings`, `global-settings`, `account`, `file-finder`, `home` | Lazy loaded, not cached |

### Memory Strategy
- Replaces `renderer: 'always'` with `<keep-alive :max="3">`
- FIFO eviction of non-primary panels from cache
- `defineAsyncComponent` for secondary + tertiary panels

### State Persistence (`useMobileLayout.js`)
- Storage key: `mobile-layout`
- Saves: `{ activeView, recentViews }` to `localStorage`
- Restores on `onMounted`

### New Files
```
client/src/components/mobile/
  MobileLayout.vue
  BottomNavBar.vue
  TopAppBar.vue
  MoreDrawer.vue
client/src/composables/
  useDevice.js
  useMobileLayout.js
```
**Modified:** `App.vue` only  
**Untouched:** `Desktop.vue`, all 19 panel components

### Mobile UX Details
- Default view: `KanbanContainer` (tasks)
- `height: 100dvh` for dynamic viewport
- `env(safe-area-inset-*)` for notch/home bar support
- `-webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch` for iOS momentum scroll
- MoreDrawer renders as 3-column icon grid bottom sheet

### Deferred Items
- Deep linking (Vue Router integration needed)
- External wiki iframe/link strategy
- Auth/session management
- Full `$ui` / `$chats` store contracts for mobile chat hydration

---
